title: Native pipeline log window
summary: Adds a native Tauri-owned Pipeline Log window opened from the topbar or Launch page. The window reuses the existing diagnostics payload, refreshes every 5 seconds, preserves/follows scroll position, and remains read-only.
reason: Operators need to keep the live pipeline log visible while using Launch or other WebView pages without making Diagnostics the active page.
behavior_before: The Pipeline Log was only visible inside Diagnostics > Logs, so checking it interrupted Launch and other operator workflows.
behavior_after: Tauri can open or refocus a single secondary window labeled pipeline-log with the same bootstrap token as the main WebView. Browser/non-Tauri users fall back to Diagnostics > Logs with an inline status instead of an exception.
